title: Choose the greater value for several types
prompt: Implement maximum for two values of one type with operator<. Return either input by value. If tied, return the first. Use it for int and std::string; there is no mixed-type overload.
signature: template<class T> T maximum(T a,T b)

tests.label: Negative integers
tests.hint: Zero is not an input here.

tests.label: Strings
tests.hint: The same template must instantiate for strings.

tests.label: Tie
tests.hint: An equal pair returns its value.

hints: The compiler makes a separate version for each used type.
Return b when a<b; otherwise return a.
explanation: template<class T> describes a type slot resolved at compilation. Instantiation needs operator< on T. Return-by-value keeps the answer after the local parameters end.
